documents.title: TDS of Bambu PLA Pure V1.0
Bambu PLA Pure Safety Data Sheet SDS20260206A19 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Pure
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 30.0 ± 3 MPa, elongation 2.8 ± 0.5 %, bending modulus 2599 ± 71 MPa, bending strength 55 ± 5 MPa, impact 10.0 ± 0.7 kJ/m² un-notched) are not stored. Density (ISO 1183) and the DSC melting and glass transition temperatures are raw-material properties and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

The TDS V1.0 has no Specifications section: material.diameter (1.75 mm), material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) and material.net_weight (1kg) stay the store page's own rows (Product Features › bullet 4; option Size › 1kg). They are not restated here and not marked not_published.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2481 ± 20 MPa, Z 2196 ± 25 MPa), melt index (11.76 ± 1.6 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), heat deflection temperature 60 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.28% at 25 °C, 55% RH) and its moisture chart, recommended re-drying interval (18 days), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.4 - 0.8 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 40 °C), max overhang angle (55 °), max bridging length (30 mm), suggested annealing (50 to 60 °C, 6 to 12 hours), colour and state, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. Nozzle sizes, AMS and printer compatibility, build plates and support material are kept as relations.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 40 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability, not a filament print setting.

Glue: the TDS ("Glue Not Recommended (Adhesive residue may compromise the contact safety of finished parts ...)"), the store FAQ ("the use of Bambu Liquid Glue or Solid Glue is not recommended") and the PLA Pure wiki (3.1 Glue Is Not Recommended) say not recommended, which is neither compatible nor incompatible, so no glue relation is written.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "A19-xx", composition (polylactic acid 95-99 %, additive printed as "5-1" % by wt), CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO/IATA) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.
Source disagreement left to review: blast-oven drying temperature, TDS 50 °C vs the PLA Pure wiki 55°C (both 8 h). The TDS value is kept with a conflict note on drying.temperature.

The material-table wiki does not name PLA Pure. Its note ② defines "PLA" as standard PLA without hard, large-particle or inorganic non-metallic fillers and names neither PLA Pure (whose wiki lists asbestos-free talc among its five ingredients) among the included nor among the excluded types, so its generic "PLA" values (nozzle 190 - 240 °C, bed 35 - 45 ℃ Cool Plate / 45 - 65 ℃ other plates, oven drying 55 ℃ for 8 h, AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT 45 ℃ for 12 h) are not applied.

Third-party results are not stored as manufacturer specs: the store page's emission comparison ("In a 4-hour continuous print test conducted by an accredited international laboratory, PLA Pure produced lower PM2.5 and PM10 emissions than a third-party PLA") and the UL, SGS and BACL certificates and test reports reproduced as images on TDS p.4.

Marketing prose proves no number: "PLA Pure matches Bambu PLA Basic in mechanical performance", "noticeably less stringing", "Reduced residue helps minimize nozzle clogs" (store page) and "noticeably lower emissions" (TDS p.1) are not stored as values.

Hex: all 5 store colours have exactly one hex cell, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses; values read from the text layer and checked against the rendered page. The table writes "Absolute Balck" for "Absolute Black (17101)".

material.spool_type is neither stored nor marked not_published: no source names the spool (the TDS has no spool row, the store page only offers Type "Filament with spool" / "Refill"), and the Type option group carries the choice.

The store page links documents that were not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/82789b66d501474797af593274bc97cd/Bambu_PLA_Pure_ROHS_REACH_PAHS_POPS_TSCA_CP65.pdf), EU 10/2011 Food Contact Report (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/660378233c314fe2bd9981d35c5ed1ad/Bambu_PLA_Pure_EU_Food_Contact_EN.pdf), EN 71-3 Toy Safety Report (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/079ff4b0c05446ba80fc4aa9923653f2/Bambu_PLA_Pure_EU_Toy_Safety_EN.pdf) and the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool. safety.certifications therefore stays unverified.

Wiki facts with no registry key are not stored: storage at ≤ 20% RH, the food-contact limits (not above 60°C or below 0°C), the expected service life of printed parts, and the slicer suggestions for higher contact safety (max volumetric speed 6 mm³/s, sparse infill 20-40%, 3-4 wall loops).
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
